title: honua-devops provision approval receipt v1
description: The durable approval that authorizes exactly one Terraform mutation. honua-devops refuses to start an apply or destroy without a valid, unexpired, single-use receipt of this shape from a configured trusted issuer. A caller boolean, an echoed challenge token, or a self-issued receipt is not authorization. This schema describes the document an issuer produces; it is an INPUT contract, and satisfying it is necessary but not sufficient - the signature must also verify under the configured issuer key.

issuer.description: Issuer identity. Must be present in the operator-configured trusted-issuer allowlist; an unknown issuer is refused.

keyId.description: First 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the issuer key, so a receipt names which key must verify it.

planSha256.description: SHA-256 of the saved binary plan this approval authorizes.

planMetadataDigest.description: The honua-iac exact-plan metadata digest. This is the value terraform-exact-apply.sh checks against --approved-digest, and it transitively binds the backend, target account and role, inputs, source revision and prior state - not just the plan bytes.

expiresAtUtc.description: Validity ceiling. honua-devops additionally refuses a receipt whose lifetime exceeds one hour.

signature.description: Base64 signature over the canonical newline-joined field sequence. 2026.1 uses HMAC-SHA256 with a symmetric issuer key; see honua-devops#147 for the open decision on moving to asymmetric issuance.
